messages:
maria_ops: Heads-up — vendor JP just flagged a supplier delay. H100 batch ETA slipping from May 6 -> May 20 for 60 units. Need replan for EU + US pools. Can vendor confirm which serials are affected and whether any units can be air‑expedited?

vendor_jp_logistics_bot: @maria_ops confirmed. Carrier capacity shortage + customs backlog at CDG. We can split into: 24 units sea (May 20), 20 units air (May 12) if customer pays expedite, 16 units on loaners immediate. Awaiting RMA approval to attach loaner SKUs. AWB and proforma pending. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

raj_sourcing: @vendor_jp_logistics_bot thanks. What’s the expedite delta per unit (air vs sea)? we need numbers to run ROI for finance. Also list the serials that can be swapped to loaners — we can't accept mismatched firmware on critical clusters.

vendor_jp_logistics_bot: Expedite + customs brokerage = +$1,850/unit (air) vs baseline sea. Loaners: model H100-LNR (firmware 1.2.3) available; can preflash to customer image but needs 48h prep. Affected serials: 8x S/Ns reservable immediately, full list in the manifest link: https://rwd.redwood/sheets/proc-manifest-MAY

sam_fleet: If we go air for 20 units to EU, that buys us headroom for high-priority infra runs. But swapping in loaners will need KV cache warmup and we might see ~15-25% perf loss on some workloads. Can we patch those via quantization profiles? That’s acceptable short-term if we avoid throttling production.

olga_finance: +1 on numbers. Put the expedite cost vs cost of missed SLAs — I need a clear compare. If expedite prevents 2 days of reduced throughput on revenue clusters, might justify. Also need PO amendment for the expedite charge.

maria_ops: Action list: 1) @raj_sourcing get exact expedite fee line by line and PO change request. 2) @vendor_jp_logistics_bot publish CSV of affected serials and indicate which can be loaners. 3) @sam_fleet give perf delta estimate per workload (short). 4) @olga_finance sign off threshold for pay. I'll hold a 30m sync at 09:30 to decide.

raj_sourcing: On it. Preliminary math: air 20 units = $37k extra. If each unit avoids 2 days of missed throughput on critical clusters, estimated recovery > $120k. I'll draft PO amendment.

vendor_jp_logistics_bot: Uploaded manifest snapshot to the sheet. CSV export:
```
serial,model,status,can_loan
HG100-0451,H100,delayed,yes
HG100-0452,H100,delayed,no
HG100-0453,H100,delayed,yes
HG100-0454,H100,delayed,yes
HG100-0455,H100,delayed,no
```

maria_ops: Quick check — sam, which workloads would be most sensitive to loaner perf? we'll rank them for the partial air ship.

sam_fleet: Ranking: 1) realtime-rl (highest sensitivity), 2) personalization-serve, 3) nightly-evals. Realtime-rl needs at least 8 true H100s, loaners ok only as stopgap. Recommend we reserve 10 of the air slots for realtime-rl and move others to loaners.

raj_sourcing: Proposed split: Air -> 12 realtime-rl critical + 8 misc infra. Sea -> remainder. Loaners -> 16 for lower-priority testbeds. I'll reflect in PO.

olga_finance: I can approve up to $40k expedite without exec signoff. If invoice > $40k we need CFO approval. raj, try to keep within that band and flag exceptions.

vendor_jp_logistics_bot: Noted. If approved today, air booking cut-off is 18:00 local; customs docs must be cleared by 16:00. Please confirm which serials to tag for air in the CSV.

maria_ops: Sending the list now. Serial tags: air-> HG100-0451, HG100-0453, HG100-0454, HG100-0460, HG100-0461, HG100-0462, HG100-0463, HG100-0464, HG100-0465, HG100-0466, HG100-0467, HG100-0468 (12 units). Rest assign to sea or loaners per manifest.

vendor_jp_logistics_bot: Confirmed. We will generate AWBs and provisional commercial invoice. AWB ETA for air shipments: May 12 (tracking tbd). For loaners, SLA for prep and flash = 48-72h.

sam_fleet: I'll validate cluster assignment and schedule KV cache prewarm for the 12 air units. Expect minor config tweaks; will post checklist in #eng-runtime.

raj_sourcing: PO amendment drafted and attached in the internal doc. Will ping @olga_finance for approval.

maria_ops: Great. Follow-ups: 1) vendor to send formal RMA addendum for the 16 loaners (loan/return terms). 2) vendor to confirm insurance coverage for split shipments (we need freight risk on proforma). 3) finance to review expedite cap.

vendor_jp_logistics_bot: RMA addendum template sent to procurement email. Insurance: standard cargo all-risk applies; we can provide value declaration on proforma.

olga_finance: Reviewing PO now. If we approve, expect charge capture in this billing cycle. Heads-up: we may want to bill expedite to product cost center (not infra) to preserve infra budget.

maria_ops: Thanks everyone. If anything changes I'll update the sheet. See you at 09:30 sync. :calendar: :shipit:
